svg.title: How to play, page 2 of 2 - weeks after that, and how it ends (A4 portrait)
svg.desc: A4 quick reference, page 2 of 2. The full weekly pulse from week 2 on (once Shit Happens, Adapt and the Ledger have turned face up, and the Specimen panel on each person board has started being read, each in their own week), and how the project ends. Page 1 (leaflet-how-to-play-A4-portrait) covers setup and Week 1. Black and white line art for cheap office printing; styling comes later.
svg.text: HOW TO PLAY
The same five days, but the table has more to say about them with every week that passes.
PAGE 2 OF 2 · WEEKS AFTER THAT, AND HOW IT ENDS
YOU'RE ON THE BACK · FLIP BACK FOR SETUP AND WEEK 1
THE PULSE, FROM WEEK 2 ON
the same five steps, every week until week 7 closes
1 · PLAN THE WEEK
Lay five Activity cards across Monday to Friday, one character disc each. Then stop. Nothing has resolved.
2 · SHIT HAPPENS
Draw two Event cards, face up - and do not resolve them yet. They are threats, aimed at the week
you already committed. A day spent on the wrong thing is simply lost.
3 · ADAPT
Spend [Adaptability]: each 1 replaces one card, or pays an Event's ADAPT number to cancel it outright.
4 · THE WEEK RUNS
Resolve whatever survived Adapt, then all five cards. Order does not matter - the week happened at once.
5 · CLOSE THE WEEK
Bank completed features (lift any lock, pay Capital) → walk the Ledger coins, at most one step each, and
flip any that reached its ring → Motivation as one net number: −1 for the grind - every week, +1 if the Need was met.
bank first - it pays the capital the ledger needs.
apply motivation as one number, then check for zero.
WEEK 2: THE LEDGER + SHIT HAPPENS/ADAPT, TOGETHER
WEEK 3: BOARD 4b + SPECIMEN PANEL - CAPITAL, NEED, OVERTIME, FLEX · WEEK 4: STANDING
HOW IT ENDS
the project ends when Week 7 closes
TEAM SCORE = (features × 10) + (4 tracks, max 20) + (Motivation) − (10 × quits) − (2 × unrepaid Flex)
FAILURE
Not everything delivered.
The score doesn't matter.
HEROIC SUCCESS
All six banked, score under 80.
The project made it. The team didn't.
HIGH PERFORMANCE
All six banked, score 80+.
You built a team as well.
If you only had thirty-five working days, how would you spend them?
